defmodule MyApp.Reports do
  import Ecto.Query

  alias MyApp.Repo
  alias Ramal.Test.Farm.{Herd, Paddock}

  # from(p in Paddock) in a comment is not a query
  def open_paddocks, do: from(p in Paddock, where: p.open) |> Repo.all()

  def by_table, do: Repo.all(from(h in "herds", select: h.name))

  def joined do
    from(h in Herd,
      join: p in Paddock,
      on: p.id == h.paddock_id
    )
  end

  def wipe, do: Repo.delete_all(Paddock)
  def bulk(rows), do: MyApp.Repo.insert_all("paddocks", rows)

  def unrelated, do: from(u in User) |> Repo.all()
end

defmodule MyApp.LegacyHerd do
  use Ecto.Schema

  schema "herds" do
    field(:name, :string)
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.Legacy do
  def all, do: MyApp.Repo.all(MyApp.LegacyHerd)
end
